what: Three families at MATCHED 128-token generation. Completes B1's pre-registered ordering test and the stance taxonomy.

zephyr_sft.EXCLUDED: 8 baseline refusals of 132. The interval spans 0-96%, so this point cannot be ordered against anything and is reported but not used. zephyr_DPO is the usable Zephyr point.

verdict_on_the_pre_registration: ORDERING HOLDS at matched generation length: Zephyr-DPO 100% > Tulu-2 70% > OLMo 2 51%, as pre-registered on 2026-09-23 before any B1 run. HONEST ON SEPARATION: Zephyr vs Tulu-2 is clean (CI 83-100 against 55-80). Tulu-2 vs OLMo 2 OVERLAPS (55-80 against 40-60) -- supported by the point estimates, not separated at 95%. Three points with one overlapping pair is an ordering, not a trend line, and it should be written as one.

the_four_stances.inability: 'I cannot', 'I'm sorry, but I can't' -- forecloses
the_four_stances.identity: 'As an AI language model, I must emphasize' -- asserts a role
the_four_stances.condemnation: 'I strongly condemn', 'I strongly advise against' -- takes a position
the_four_stances.normative: 'Bribery is illegal and unethical' -- the act is the subject
the_four_stances.note: Each family has a DOMINANT stance: OLMo 2 inability (128/130), Tulu-2 inability with identity secondary (78/20), Zephyr-DPO condemnation (24/30). The taxonomy grew from two to four across three families, but it is converging rather than exploding -- the fourth was predicted by O-121 before this run.

identity -- UNTOUCHED.tulu2: 20 -> 21. The only family with enough of it to test, and ablation does not remove it at all.

condemnation -- CONFOUNDED.zephyr_dpo: 24 -> 0, but Zephyr's total goes 30 -> 0, so this cannot be attributed to the stance rather than to the model simply losing all refusal.

WHAT_THE_DIRECTION_MEDIATES.claim: The direction mediates INABILITY refusal. That is the only stance removed in every family that has it, and the one stance we can test against a survivor (identity, 20 -> 21) shows it is not a general 'refusal' effect.

why_sufficiency_differs: Sufficiency = the inability share of baseline refusals, minus whatever fallback appears. OLMo 2: 128/130 inability removed, but 64 normative appear -> 51%. Tulu-2: 78/100 removed, 21 identity survive -> 70%. Zephyr-DPO: everything goes, no fallback -> 100%. The ordering is therefore about FALLBACK CAPACITY, not about how much refusal the direction carries.
open: Zephyr-SFT is unusable at n=8. Llama-2-chat (pre-registered rank 1) is unrun and gated. The dose curve and P1-E7's 0.477 remain 48-token measurements.
